scope: Rosstat organizations excluding small businesses; workforce headcount counts jobs/workplace, resident population all ages; ratio is not employment rate
observed_identity: exact observed OKTMO eight-digit at observation year; year-valid SberIndex stable territory ID, source name corroboration, never source oktmo_stable replacement
missingness: No zero-fill, suppressed/missing remain missing; no averaging duplicate keys; broadsector shares require published numerator+total
blocked_evaluation: Leave-one-region-out; every probe fit uses other regions only; type+logpopulation+logexpense baseline (no held-out region effect or outcome centering); fixed five continuous consumer features as strong comparator; frozen KMeans4 as cluster predictor
outcome_selection: No outcome-driven choice of clustering or new clustering fit; primary labels predate newlyacquired outcomes
inference: Descriptive/retrospective external association; no causality, industrial typology, forecast or benefit beyond continuous features claimed
multiplicity: Family of five outcomes separately per year, report all and Holm adjustment for within-region permutation tests; exploratory secondary outcomes
